title: An Empirical Analysis of Parameter-Efficient Methods for Debiasing Pre-Trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring stereotype scores by evaluating the language model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical associations using the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet datasets, as well as testing downstream coreference resolution performance using the WinoBias dataset.

Measuring stereotype scores by evaluating the language model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence completions and associations using the racial subsets of the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet datasets.

Measuring stereotype scores by evaluating the language model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence completions and associations using the religious subsets of the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet datasets.
